lines.text: Listen carefully. Which word is am? Am.
Let us build an. A, N, an.
Listen carefully. Which word is at? At.
Listen carefully. Which word is in? In.
The book is on the table. Which little word tells where the book is? On.
Read: It is up. Which little word says where? Up.
Let us practise little words: am, an, at, in, is, it, on, up. Tell me one short phrase with a little word.
Good try. Listen again and have another go.
Your homework: say It is up and I walk to school with someone at home.
Now we are going to school. Look, I am walking. Walk, walk. Can you say walk?
Look around our little garden. Can you find the school? Say school or point to it.
Tell me one small thing you like to do at school. You may start with: I play.
Today you learnt eight little words and talked about school. At home, say It is up and I walk to school.
